## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-post-skill-attribution.sh exists
  Verify: test -f tests/hooks/test-post-skill-attribution.sh
- [ ] test_hook_record_skill_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_hook_record_skill_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled' tests/hooks/test-post-skill-attribution.sh
- [ ] test_post_skill_dispatcher_appends_skill_entry_to_jsonl function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_post_skill_dispatcher_appends_skill_entry_to_jsonl' tests/hooks/test-post-skill-attribution.sh
- [ ] Tests run in fresh subshells (subshell invocation pattern present)
  Verify: grep -q 'bash.*test_hook_record_skill_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled\|(\s*test_hook_record_skill_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled' tests/hooks/test-post-skill-attribution.sh
- [ ] Tests are RED (fail) before T2a-impl is implemented
